name: Teleno Koinos Node
description: Teleno node with a live mining overview: independent wallet, balances, sync health, confirmed blocks, KOIN rewards and dated history. Native Linux x64 / ARM64 (64-bit Raspberry Pi OS), Windows x64 through WSL2, and optional x64 Docker. Checksum-pinned Teleno 1.3.0 engine, local RPC, snapshots and public bootstrap.
